summary: Diff adds a new Administrator-specific access screen component and updates the existing AdminPasswordGate to use i18n keys and some additional validation/styling. However, the diff summary does not clearly show the required rendering condition (isAdmin && !isGatePassed) being wired up, and it does not provide evidence that the new AdminAccessScreen i18n keys were added to both en and pt-BR dictionaries. The diff also includes several unrelated product changes (per the frontend-file-summaries.txt) that were not requested.

missing_requirements.reason: AdminAccessScreen was added, but the provided App.tsx snippet is truncated before any admin routing/gate conditional is shown; there is no explicit evidence in the diff excerpt that the app actually renders AdminAccessScreen under the specified condition.

missing_requirements.requirement: All user-facing text for the Administrator login/access screen must come from i18n and have English strings (and pt-BR equivalents where supported).
missing_requirements.reason: AdminAccessScreen uses new i18n keys (e.g., adminAccessScreenTitle/subtitle/feature/help), but the shown en.ts and pt-BR.ts excerpts are truncated and do not show those keys being defined; the diff summary does not provide evidence that both languages contain the new strings.
